annotations.text:
Premium staff portal — the 10/10 target, phone-first.
Staff live on their phones, so the mobile row leads: Home, My Day, Pay, Leave, Reimbursements share one 5-tab shell.
Amana tokens throughout. All figures are sample data. Edit anything, then Save.
Every screen: one hero action at the top (clock in, roll call, view payslip, apply, snap receipt), 44px+ tap targets, glanceable numbers before detail.
Desktop versions of the same screens — same hierarchy, more breathing room.
Staff file (HR side): real tabs replace the long scroll. Overview answers the three questions HR opens a file for — compliant? paid right? anything pending?
